policies.sentence: Students must include the prompts they used, in a file, README, comments, or the hand-in.
Students must submit the full conversation, transcript, or session record of their AI interactions.
Students must keep complete records of their AI interactions for possible review, and are encouraged to use a logging tool.
Students must not edit, truncate, tamper with, scrub, or regenerate transcripts and logs, and must attest they are complete.
Links to logs are not accepted as submitted transcripts.
Students must submit each AI session report within 24 hours of the conversation.
Integrity policies cover students' agent session transcripts and the activity their hooks report.
The instructional team may ask students for their prompt transcripts.
